slides.heading: How you know it worked
items: Twenty or more blind listeners: an ABX and preference test against the studio master, scripted shuffle, results in listening.csv with a binomial confidence interval.
Ten existing listeners: pre-sale conversions at a price of at least 2.5x quantity-10 BOM cost.
slides.alt: DejaViewed carousel, slide 7 of 9. Proof. How you know it worked. Twenty or more blind listeners: an ABX and preference test against the studio master, scripted shuffle, results in listening.csv with a binomial confidence interval. Ten existing listeners: pre-sale conversions at a price of at least 2.5x quantity-10 BOM cost.

slides.heading: Inaudible variation
paras: listeners cannot tell device takes apart.
require a minimum number of changed stems between plays and vary section order.
